author: Seung Wook
problem: A store sells packs of 6 eggs for S yen, 8 eggs for M yen and 12 eggs for L yen. Print the minimum amount of money needed to buy at least N eggs, buying any number of each pack.
bug_description: The condition i+j+l>=n adds the pack counts and the 12-pack price L instead of the egg total 6*i+8*j+12*k, so it is true whenever L >= N and the answer is then 0.

comments.accurate: Tries every number of 6-, 8- and 12-egg packs and prints the cheapest total with at least N eggs
comments.wrong_behavior: Tries every pack combination and keeps the cheapest one where the 6- and 8-pack counts plus L reach N
comments.wrong_location: Egg condition verified; check the range of 101 packs per size, which may be too small for large N
